properties.name: --lr-form-control-required-content
properties.description:
**`<lr-checkbox-group>`, `<lr-combobox>`, `<lr-emoji-picker>`, `<lr-file-input>`, `<lr-model-select>`, `<lr-radio-group>`, `<lr-select>`, `<lr-slider>`, `<lr-token-input>`, `<lr-voice-picker>`** (default: `' *'`) — The required marker appended to `form-control-label` while `required` is set. Set it to `''` to suppress the marker, or to any other quoted string (`' (required)'`, a localized word) to replace it.

**`<lr-code-editor>`, `<lr-color-picker>`, `<lr-date-input>`, `<lr-input>`, `<lr-locale-picker>`, `<lr-native-time-input>`, `<lr-number-input>`, `<lr-otp-input>`, `<lr-phone-input>`, `<lr-textarea>`, `<lr-time-input>`** (default: `' *'`) — The required-field marker rendered after the label. Set it to `''` to suppress the marker, or to any other quoted string (`' (required)'`, a localized word) to replace it. Caller-supplied content, so it is never localized here.

**`<lr-known-date>`** (default: `' *'`) — The required-field marker, rendered after the `legend` box. Set it to `''` to suppress the marker, or to any other quoted string (`' (required)'`, a localized word) to replace it. Caller-supplied content, so it is never localized here.

**`<lr-rubric-form>`** (default: `' *'`) — Required-field marker after rubric-owned score and unsupported-field labels. Set it to `''` to suppress the marker, or to any other quoted string (`' (required)'`, a localized word) to replace it.

**`<lr-tool-param-form>`** (default: `' *'`) — The required-field marker rendered after the `label` part of every field whose key is listed in the schema's `required` array — per field here, not per host, because this control's value is a whole object. Set it to `''` to suppress the marker, or to any other quoted string (`' (required)'`, a localized word) to replace it. Caller-supplied content, so it is never localized here.

properties.name: --lr-form-control-required-offset
properties.description:
**`<lr-checkbox-group>`, `<lr-combobox>`, `<lr-emoji-picker>`, `<lr-file-input>`, `<lr-model-select>`, `<lr-radio-group>`, `<lr-select>`, `<lr-slider>`, `<lr-token-input>`, `<lr-voice-picker>`** (default: `0`) — Inline space between the label text and the required marker.

**`<lr-code-editor>`, `<lr-color-picker>`, `<lr-date-input>`, `<lr-input>`, `<lr-known-date>`, `<lr-locale-picker>`, `<lr-native-time-input>`, `<lr-number-input>`, `<lr-otp-input>`, `<lr-phone-input>`, `<lr-textarea>`, `<lr-time-input>`, `<lr-tool-param-form>`** (default: `0`) — Inline space between the label text and the marker.

**`<lr-rubric-form>`** (default: `0`) — Inline space between the label text and marker.

properties.name: --lr-icon-button-radius

properties.name: --lr-icon-button-size

A library-wide token (declared on `:root` by `tokens.styles.ts`, and the shared minimum tappable size several other components size their icon controls against), so overriding it globally resizes all of them together.

**Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for icon button size. Reads `--lr-theme-icon-button-size`.

properties.name: --lr-icon-rotate

properties.name: --lr-icon-size
properties.description: **`<lr-icon>`** — Optional inline and block size override for every canvas.

properties.name: --lr-image-comparer-divider-width

properties.name: --lr-image-comparer-handle-size

properties.name: --lr-scroll-fade-size
properties.description:
**`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `2rem`) — Width of the fade at each horizontal scroll edge. The fade is applied only while the track actually overflows, so a row that fits is never dimmed.

**`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `2rem`) — Width of each decorative horizontal overflow fade. Pointer-state hooks use inline `var()` fallbacks rather than a `:host` declaration, so they inherit from the stepper or any ancestor without retheming another state.

**`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `2rem`) — Width of the fade at each horizontal scroll edge. The fade is applied only while the tablist actually overflows, so a row that fits is never dimmed.

**`<lr-timeline>`** (default: `2rem`) — Inline size of each edge fade while a horizontal timeline overflows. Forced-colors mode disables the masks while retaining native scrolling.

**`<lr-widget>`** (default: `2rem`) — Width of the fade at each horizontal scroll edge of the `actions`/`view-toggles` header rows. The fade is applied only while a row actually overflows, so a row that fits is never dimmed. `fullscreen-inset` overrides the safe-area panel inset while the viewport-filling backdrop stays at zero by default. `compact` tightens header/body padding — same convention as `lr-empty`.

**Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for scroll fade size. Reads `--lr-theme-scroll-fade-size`.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-segment-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-form-control-padding-block) var(--lr-form-control-padding-inline)`) — Each segment's padding, taken from the `size` tier's shared control padding.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-selected-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Background of the checked segment. Scoped to `[aria-checked='true']` only, so it never repaints a hovered unselected segment (which is what hijacking `--lr-color-surface` library-wide used to do).

properties.name: --lr-segmented-selected-color
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of the checked segment.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-selected-font-weight
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-weight-semibold)`) — Font weight of the checked segment.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-selected-shadow
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-shadow-xs)`) — Box shadow lifting the checked segment off the track.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-track-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-0-125rem)`) — Gap between segments.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-track-height
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** — Exact height of the `base` track, pinning it at every `size` tier (sets both `block-size` and `min-block-size`) so the row can sit flush beside a hard-sized toolbar control. **Genuinely unset by default** — while unset each tier keeps its own `--lr-segmented-track-min-height` floor and the track grows with its content.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-track-min-height
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-form-control-height)`) — Minimum height of the `base` track, taken from the `size` tier's shared control height; the `2.5rem` (40px) default applies at the unset/`m` size, matching `<lr-input>`/`<lr-select>`/`<lr-combobox>`'s own shared default-tier floor. The private default follows `size`; a public value inherited from an ancestor or set directly on the element remains authoritative in every tier.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-track-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-0-125rem)`) — Track inset padding.

properties.name: --lr-segmented-track-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-segmented>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius)`) — Track corner radius.

properties.name: --lr-select-expand-size
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** — Decorative expand-icon box size, scaled by `size`. The one piece of this component's geometry the shared ladder does not own: it sizes a glyph, not the control row.

properties.name: --lr-select-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-form-control-font-size)`) — Trigger font size, from the active `size` tier.

properties.name: --lr-select-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** — Gap between the trigger's start adornment, label, end adornment, and expand icon. Doesn't vary by `size`.

properties.name: --lr-select-open-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Trigger border while the listbox is open.

properties.name: --lr-select-option-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Background of the hovered/keyboard-active option row. Not declared on `:host`, so a value set on any ancestor is never shadowed -- retheme just this row state without hijacking the shared `--lr-color-brand-quiet` token used by every other component's own hover/active state.

properties.name: --lr-select-option-selected-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `transparent`) — Background of the currently-selected option row. Not declared on `:host`; retheme just the selected row without hijacking `--lr-color-brand`.

properties.name: --lr-select-option-selected-border
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Border color of the selected option row.

properties.name: --lr-select-option-selected-color
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Text color of the selected option row.

properties.name: --lr-select-option-selected-font-weight
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-weight-semibold)`) — Font weight of the selected option row.

properties.name: --lr-select-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-form-control-radius)`) — Trigger corner radius, from the active `size` tier of the shared form-control ladder (the two tightest tiers take a smaller radius).

properties.name: --lr-select-tag-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** — Chip text size. Doesn't vary by `size`.

properties.name: --lr-select-tag-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** — Padding inside a `multiple`-mode chip. Doesn't vary by `size`.

properties.name: --lr-select-trigger-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `color-mix(...)`) — Trigger background while pressed.

properties.name: --lr-select-trigger-height
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** — Exact trigger height. Unset by default, which leaves `--lr-select-trigger-min-height` as a floor only; set it to a length to both floor and cap the trigger (e.g. to pixel-match a sibling field in the same toolbar row). Because it is never declared by the component itself, it can be set from an ancestor or an outer-tree rule as well as inline on the element.

properties.name: --lr-select-trigger-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Trigger background while hovered. Accent appearance keeps its louder mixed fallback when this hook is unset.

properties.name: --lr-select-trigger-min-height
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** (default: `var(--lr-form-control-height)`) — Trigger block-size floor, from the active `size` tier of the shared ladder, and live at every tier including the default `m` -- so a select is exactly as tall as an `<lr-button>`/`<lr-input>` of that tier.

properties.name: --lr-select-trigger-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-select>`** — Trigger padding shorthand. Defaults to the active `size` tier's `var(--lr-form-control-padding-block) var(--lr-form-control-padding-inline)` from the shared ladder.

properties.name: --lr-selection-toolbar-placement-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-selection-toolbar>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-s)`) — Non-negative distance between the selection and toolbar, and between the toolbar and viewport during collision avoidance. Unitless pixel values and `px`, `rem`, and `em` values are resolved live; invalid values fall back to the default and negative values clamp to `0`.

properties.name: --lr-sequence-playback-icon-size
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-playback>`** (default: `calc(var(--lr-icon-button-size) * 0.35)`) — Font size of the play/pause glyph, derived from the shared icon-button hit-target size.

properties.name: --lr-sequence-playback-play-button-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-playback>`** — Pressed play/pause button background. Defaults to the existing surface active mix; read as an inline fallback so an ancestor value inherits.

properties.name: --lr-sequence-playback-play-button-active-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-playback>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Pressed play/pause button border color; read as an inline fallback so an ancestor value inherits.

properties.name: --lr-sequence-strip-height
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-strip>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-1-5rem)`) — Block size of the strip.

properties.name: --lr-sequence-strip-legend-marker-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-strip>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface-raised)`) — Neutral chip background behind the marker legend row's bar; it stands in for "any cell", so it deliberately matches no category color.

properties.name: --lr-sequence-strip-legend-swatch-size
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-strip>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-0-625rem)`) — Inline and block size of a legend swatch (category and marker rows alike).

properties.name: --lr-sequence-strip-marker-color
properties.description: **`<lr-sequence-strip>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Color of the bottom marker on a `marker: true` cell, and of the marker legend row's bar.

properties.name: --lr-slider-track-length
properties.description: **`<lr-slider>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-10rem)`) — Length of the track in `orientation="vertical"`; the horizontal track fills its container instead. Declared as an inline `var()` fallback (never on `:host`), so a consumer override at any ancestor wins.

properties.name: --lr-slider-track-thickness
properties.description: **`<lr-slider>`** (default: `calc(var(--lr-slider-thumb-size) * 0.25)`) — Thickness of the track, the filled indicator and (scaled from it) the `with-markers` ticks.

properties.name: --lr-source-card-compact-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-source-card>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — Gap between `[part="base"]`'s rows while `compact`.

properties.name: --lr-source-card-compact-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-source-card>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-xs)`) — `[part="base"]` padding while `compact`.

properties.name: --lr-source-picker-checked-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-source-picker>`** — Background of a fully-checked selection control: the `select-all` pill (defaults to `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) and a fully-selected entry's `[part="checkbox"]` (defaults to `var(--lr-color-brand)`). The two keep their distinct resting defaults; setting this prop unifies both.

properties.name: --lr-source-picker-checked-border
properties.description: **`<lr-source-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Border color of every checked or mixed selection control.

properties.name: --lr-source-picker-depth
properties.description: **`<lr-source-picker>`** (default: `0`) — Internal indent plumbing, not a retheming knob: the row's own nesting depth, written inline onto `[part="item"]` as a plain number and multiplied by `--lr-source-picker-indent-size` to produce the indent.

properties.name: --lr-source-picker-indent-size
properties.description: **`<lr-source-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-1-25rem)`) — Indent step added to `[part="item"]`'s `padding-inline-start` per nesting level. The total indent is capped at `--lr-size-8rem` so a deeply nested tree cannot push its labels out of view.

properties.name: --lr-source-picker-mixed-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-source-picker>`** (default: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--lr-color-brand) 50%, var(--lr-color-surface))`) — Background of a partially-selected entry's `[part="checkbox"]`.

properties.name: --lr-space-2xl
properties.description: **Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for space 2xl. Reads `--lr-theme-space-2xl`.

properties.name: --lr-space-2xs
properties.description: **Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for space 2xs. Reads `--lr-theme-space-2xs`.

properties.name: --lr-space-l
properties.description: **Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for space l. Reads `--lr-theme-space-l`.

properties.name: --lr-space-m
properties.description: **Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for space m. Reads `--lr-theme-space-m`.

properties.name: --lr-space-s
properties.description: **Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for space s. Reads `--lr-theme-space-s`.

properties.name: --lr-space-xs
properties.description: **Shared design token** — Canonical shared component token for space xs. Reads `--lr-theme-space-xs`.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-denied-color
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning)`) — Denied bar fill.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-error-color
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-danger)`) — Error bar fill.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-name-width
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `8rem`) — Width of the name gutter column.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-pending-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border-strong)`) — Pending bar border.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-row-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Background of the active (`activeSpanId`) row. Shadow Parts forbids an attribute selector after `::part()`, so the active row could otherwise only be restyled by hijacking the library-wide `--lr-color-brand-quiet` token.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-running-color
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Running stripe foreground.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-running-stripe-color
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Running stripe background.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-stripe-speed
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-duration-ambient)`) — Animation duration for a `running` span's striped bar. The fallback is the bare-duration `--lr-duration-ambient`, not the `--lr-transition-ambient` duration+easing shorthand, which would be invalid in an `animation-duration` slot.

properties.name: --lr-span-waterfall-success-color
properties.description: **`<lr-span-waterfall>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-success)`) — Success bar fill.

properties.name: --lr-sparkline-stroke-width
properties.description: **`<lr-sparkline>`** (default: `var(--lr-border-width-medium)`) — Compatibility alias used as the fallback for `--line-width`.

properties.name: --lr-spinner-duration
properties.description: **`<lr-spinner>`** (default: `var(--lr-transition-ambient)`) — Duration/easing of one rotation. Not read under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, where the animation is disabled entirely.

properties.name: --lr-spinner-size
properties.description: **`<lr-spinner>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-1-25rem)`) — Outer diameter of the indicator.

properties.name: --lr-spinner-track-width
properties.description: **`<lr-spinner>`** (default: `var(--lr-border-width-medium)`) — Thickness of the ring track.

properties.name: --lr-split-panel-divider-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-split-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border-strong)`) — Background of `divider` while being dragged (or focused and pressed via the keyboard).

properties.name: --lr-split-panel-divider-hit-area
properties.description: **`<lr-split-panel>`** (default: `var(--divider-hit-area)`) — Lyra-prefixed hit-area alias.

properties.name: --lr-split-panel-divider-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-split-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Background of `divider` on hover/keyboard focus, independent of any other component's own hover token that happens to default to the same shared brand color.

properties.name: --lr-split-panel-divider-width
properties.description: **`<lr-split-panel>`** (default: `var(--divider-width)`) — Lyra-prefixed divider-width alias.

properties.name: --lr-split-panel-max
properties.description: **`<lr-split-panel>`** (default: `var(--max)`) — Lyra-prefixed maximum-size alias.

properties.name: --lr-split-panel-min
properties.description: **`<lr-split-panel>`** (default: `var(--min)`) — Lyra-prefixed minimum-size alias.

properties.name: --lr-spreadsheet-viewer-highlight-color
properties.description: **`<lr-spreadsheet-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Outline color of a highlighted cell. The active highlight changes a private warning-color default; an inherited or direct public value remains authoritative.

properties.name: --lr-spreadsheet-viewer-highlight-outline-offset
properties.description: **`<lr-spreadsheet-viewer>`** (default: `calc(-1 * var(--lr-border-width-medium))`) — Outline offset of a highlighted cell.

properties.name: --lr-spreadsheet-viewer-max-height
properties.description: **`<lr-spreadsheet-viewer>`** (default: `none`) — Maximum block size of `[part="body"]` before it scrolls internally. The `maxHeight` property sets this token inline on `[part="base"]`.

properties.name: --lr-stack-trace-compact-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-stack-trace>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — Space below `[part="message"]` and between `[part="group"]`s while `compact`.

properties.name: --lr-stack-trace-compact-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-stack-trace>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — `[part="base"]` padding while `compact`. Overridden entirely by `frame="plain"`.

properties.name: --lr-stack-trace-font
properties.description: **`<lr-stack-trace>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-mono)`) — Font family for the parsed frames and the verbatim raw fallback.

properties.name: --lr-stack-trace-interactive-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stack-trace>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Interactive frame/toggle accent.

properties.name: --lr-stack-trace-internal-frame-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stack-trace>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text-quiet)`) — Internal frame foreground.

properties.name: --lr-stack-trace-max-height
properties.description: **`<lr-stack-trace>`** (default: `none`) — Cap on how tall `[part="base"]` grows before it scrolls internally. `none` lets the component grow with its content; the `max-height` attribute sets this token.

properties.name: --lr-stat-emphasis-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Accent-edge color when `emphasis` is set. Independent of the headline's emphasis tint and `brand` variant.

properties.name: --lr-stat-emphasis-value-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Headline value color when `emphasis` is set on a neutral stat. Independent of the accent edge and `brand` variant.

properties.name: --lr-stat-link-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `color-mix(...)`) — Linked-card background while pressed.

properties.name: --lr-stat-link-active-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-stat-link-hover-border-color,var(--lr-color-brand))`) — Linked-card border while pressed.

properties.name: --lr-stat-link-active-shadow
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-stat-link-hover-shadow,var(--lr-shadow-s))`) — Linked-card shadow while pressed.

properties.name: --lr-stat-link-hover-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Linked-card border on hover.

properties.name: --lr-stat-link-hover-shadow
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-shadow-s)`) — Linked-card shadow on hover.

properties.name: --lr-stat-trend-bad-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--lr-color-danger) 8%, transparent)`) — Background of the trend pill when its polarity is "bad".

properties.name: --lr-stat-trend-bad-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-danger)`) — Text color of the trend pill when its polarity is "bad". Independent of the headline value's `variant="danger"` tint, which reads the shared `--lr-color-danger` token directly.

properties.name: --lr-stat-trend-good-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--lr-color-success) 8%, transparent)`) — Background of the trend pill when its polarity is "good".

properties.name: --lr-stat-trend-good-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-success)`) — Text color of the trend pill when its polarity is "good". Independent of the headline value's `variant="success"` tint, which reads the shared `--lr-color-success` token directly.

properties.name: --lr-stat-value-brand-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Headline value color for the `brand` variant.

properties.name: --lr-stat-value-danger-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-danger)`) — Headline value color for the `danger` variant.

properties.name: --lr-stat-value-success-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-success)`) — Headline value color for the `success` variant.

properties.name: --lr-stat-value-warning-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stat>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning)`) — Headline value color for the `warning` variant.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `color-mix(in oklab, var(--lr-color-brand-quiet), var(--lr-color-mix-partner) var(--lr-color-mix-active))`) — Background of a pressed, non-disabled step.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of a pressed, non-disabled step.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-current-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of the `current` step. Declared as an inline `var()` fallback (never on `:host`), so setting it on the element or an ancestor recolors only the current step without hijacking the library-wide `--lr-color-text` token.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-current-font-weight
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-weight-semibold)`) — Font weight of the `current` step's label. `::part(step)[data-state='current']` is invalid CSS (an attribute selector cannot follow `::part`), so this is the only way to change just the current step's boldness without hijacking the library-wide `--lr-font-weight-semibold` token.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-current-index-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Background of the `current` step's numbered index chip (`step-index`).

properties.name: --lr-stepper-current-index-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-on-brand)`) — Text color of the `current` step's numbered index chip.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-error-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-danger)`) — Text color of an `error` step.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Background of a hovered, non-disabled step.

properties.name: --lr-stepper-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stepper>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of a hovered, non-disabled step.

properties.name: --lr-stream-status-dot-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stream-status>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text-quiet)`) — `indicator` dot color. Its private default changes with reflected `connection-state` and the component-owned `data-stalled` state: `var(--lr-color-brand)` for `connecting`/`streaming`, `var(--lr-color-warning)` for `stalled`. Set it on the element or any ancestor; an element value wins.

properties.name: --lr-stream-status-dot-opacity
properties.description: **`<lr-stream-status>`** (default: `0.35`) — `indicator` dot opacity. Its private default changes with those same host states: `0.6` for `connecting`, `1` for `streaming` and `stalled`. Set it on the element or any ancestor; an element value wins.

properties.name: --lr-stream-status-message-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stream-status>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning)`) — `phase` and `message` text color while `data-stalled` is present. Decoupled from `--lr-stream-status-stalled-border-color` even though both fall back to the same shared token today.

properties.name: --lr-stream-status-stalled-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-stream-status>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning-quiet)`) — `base` row background while `data-stalled` is present.

properties.name: --lr-stream-status-stalled-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-stream-status>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning)`) — `base` row border color while `data-stalled` is present.

properties.name: --lr-subagent-panel-progress-fill
properties.description: **`<lr-subagent-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Progress fill.

properties.name: --lr-subagent-panel-progress-track
properties.description: **`<lr-subagent-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Progress track.

properties.name: --lr-subagent-panel-selected-border
properties.description: **`<lr-subagent-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Selected run border.

properties.name: --lr-suggestion-chips-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-suggestion-chips>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Background of a hovered chip.

properties.name: --lr-suggestion-chips-hover-border
properties.description: **`<lr-suggestion-chips>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Border color of a hovered chip.

properties.name: --lr-suggestion-chips-justify
properties.description: **`<lr-suggestion-chips>`** (default: `flex-start`) — Main-axis packing of the chip row. `center` centers every line, the wrapped final one included — what `::part(base)` alone cannot do.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-active-border
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning, var(--lr-color-brand))`) — Border color of the `[part="region-highlight"]` matching `activeHighlightId`. Distinct from the resting highlight border, so the active region can be recolored without touching the rest.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-highlight-accent-color
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Accent highlight border and hover tint.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-highlight-danger-color
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-danger)`) — Danger highlight border and hover tint.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-highlight-neutral-color
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-neutral)`) — Neutral highlight border and hover tint.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-highlight-success-color
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-success)`) — Success highlight border and hover tint.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-highlight-warning-color
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning)`) — Warning highlight border and hover tint.

properties.name: --lr-svg-viewer-max-height
properties.description: **`<lr-svg-viewer>`** (default: `none`) — Maximum block size of the scrollable body before it scrolls internally. Also settable via the `max-height` property.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-fill-size
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-theme-swatch-picker-fill-size, var(--lr-size-1-5rem))`) — Visible fill/icon diameter for the swatch. Its private default follows the active tier. Set `--lr-theme-swatch-picker-fill-size` on an ancestor to give every tier a shared default, or set this component hook on an ancestor/direct host to override every tier.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-xs)`) — Gap between swatches.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-gemstone-selected-blur
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-0-5rem)`) — Selected glow blur used by `mode="gemstone"` when `--lr-swatch-picker-selected-blur` is not overridden.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-gemstone-shine-duration
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-transition-ambient)`) — Selected shine timing used by `mode="gemstone"` when `--lr-swatch-picker-shine-duration` is not overridden.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-hit-size
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-2-5rem)`) — Hit-area size (both min-inline-size and min-block-size) for the swatch button. Its private default follows the active tier and is floored at 24px; an inherited or direct public value wins.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-selected-blur
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `0`) — Blur radius of that same ring. 0 by default (a crisp ring); set a real length (e.g. 0.4rem) for a soft glow instead.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-selected-color
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Ring color drawn around the selected swatch, themeable independently of the focus ring and every other ring color.

properties.name: --lr-swatch-picker-shine-duration
properties.description: **`<lr-swatch-picker>`** (default: `0s`) — Duration of a rhythmic brighten-and-settle "shine" on the selected swatch. `0s` (the default) is a no-op -- today's static look for every existing consumer. Set a real duration (e.g. 1.6s) for a pulsing shine; disabled outright under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Independent of `--lr-swatch-picker-selected-blur` (a separate `filter: brightness()` animation, not `box-shadow`), so the two compose freely, and works identically for a plain color circle and an icon swatch alike.

properties.name: --lr-switch-checked-track-fill
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Track fill while checked.

properties.name: --lr-switch-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-s)`) — Gap between the track and label.

properties.name: --lr-switch-thumb-fill
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Thumb fill in either checked state.

properties.name: --lr-switch-thumb-offset
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-2px)`) — Inset of the thumb from the track's edges.

properties.name: --lr-switch-track-active-fill
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `color-mix(...)`) — Track fill while pressed.

properties.name: --lr-switch-track-block-size
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `calc(var(--lr-form-control-height) * 0.5)`) — Block size of the track, half the `size` tier's shared control height; the thumb's diameter is derived from it minus twice `--lr-switch-thumb-offset`.

properties.name: --lr-switch-track-fill
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Resting fill of `[part='track']`, used as the source for the hover and press fallbacks.

properties.name: --lr-switch-track-hover-fill
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `color-mix(...)`) — Track fill while hovered.

properties.name: --lr-switch-track-inline-size
properties.description: **`<lr-switch>`** (default: `calc(var(--lr-switch-track-block-size) * 1.8)`) — Inline size of the track, and (with the block size) the distance the thumb travels when checked. Derived from the block size, so re-sizing the track keeps its aspect ratio.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `color-mix(in oklab, transparent, var(--lr-color-mix-partner) var(--lr-color-mix-active))`) — Background of a pressed, non-disabled tab.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-tab-group-hover-color, var(--lr-color-text))`) — Text color of a pressed, non-disabled tab.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of a hovered, non-disabled tab. Independent of the selected-state props above. Pressed-tab and scroll-control hooks use inline `var()` fallbacks rather than a `:host` declaration, so they inherit from the group or any ancestor without retheming the other states.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-indicator-color
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Color of the selected tab's underline, themeable independently of its text color.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-scroll-button-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `color-mix(in oklab, transparent, var(--lr-color-mix-partner) var(--lr-color-mix-active))`) — Background of a pressed overflow scroll control.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-scroll-button-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of a pressed overflow scroll control.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-scroll-button-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Text color of a hovered overflow scroll control.

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-selected-color
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Text color of the selected tab. Scoped to `[aria-selected='true']` only, so it never repaints a hovered unselected tab (which is what hijacking `--lr-color-brand` library-wide used to do).

properties.name: --lr-tab-group-vertical-nav-max-inline-size
properties.description: **`<lr-tab-group>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-12rem)`) — Maximum logical inline size of a vertical `start`/`end` nav. Long labels ellipsize inside that bound so the panel remains usable at narrow allocations.

properties.name: --lr-table-cell-color
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `inherit`) — Text colour of body cells; inherits the host's own colour by default.

properties.name: --lr-table-cell-link-color
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Colour of an anchor returned from a column's `cell(row)`. Such an anchor renders inside this component's shadow root, so page CSS cannot reach it and `::part()` cannot select past the first compound selector to reach it either; without this hook it computes to the UA default link blue. Set `revert` for the UA default.

properties.name: --lr-table-cell-link-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-table-cell-link-color,var(--lr-color-brand))`) — Colour of that anchor on hover and `:focus-visible`, which also thicken its underline.

properties.name: --lr-table-header-sorted-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Background of the currently-sorted column's header cell (`[aria-sort]` other than `none`). Same rationale as `--lr-table-row-selected-bg`: `::part(header-cell)[aria-sort]` is invalid CSS, so this token is the supported way to recolor the sorted header without hijacking a library-wide token.

properties.name: --lr-table-header-sorted-color
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `inherit`) — Text color of the currently-sorted column's header cell.

properties.name: --lr-table-heat-t
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** — This cell's position on the heat-tint ramp, as a percentage string. Set inline by the component on each `[data-heat]` cell; not consumer-settable.

properties.name: --lr-table-heat-tint-hi
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — High endpoint of the heat-tint ramp used by `heatValue` columns. Inherits from theme ancestors.

properties.name: --lr-table-heat-tint-lo
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Low endpoint of the heat-tint ramp used by `heatValue` columns. Inherits from theme ancestors.

properties.name: --lr-table-max-height
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `none`) — Cap on the scroll container's block size, past which the table body scrolls.

properties.name: --lr-table-resize-handle-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-table-resize-handle-hover-bg,var(--lr-color-brand))`) — Resize-handle pressed background.

properties.name: --lr-table-resize-handle-active-opacity
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `calc(var(--lr-table-resize-handle-hover-opacity,var(--lr-table-resize-handle-opacity,0.12))*2)`) — Resize-handle pressed opacity.

properties.name: --lr-table-resize-handle-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Resize-handle hover/focus background.

properties.name: --lr-table-resize-handle-hover-opacity
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-table-resize-handle-opacity,0.12)`) — Resize-handle hover/focus opacity.

properties.name: --lr-table-resize-handle-opacity
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `0.12`) — Hover/focus opacity of the resize handle. Legacy shared-state hook; inherits from theme ancestors.

properties.name: --lr-table-resize-min-width
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-3rem)`) — Default minimum width for a resizable column without an explicit pixel `minWidth`. Inherits from theme ancestors.

properties.name: --lr-table-row-selected-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Background of a row whose `aria-selected` is `true`. Shadow Parts forbids an attribute selector after `::part()`, so `::part(row)[aria-selected]` is invalid CSS and the selected row could otherwise only be restyled by hijacking the library-wide `--lr-color-brand-quiet` token.

properties.name: --lr-table-row-stripe-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `transparent`) — Background of alternating body rows. The token is read only on rows carrying the internal stripe marker, so it can be set on the table or an ancestor without affecting group, expanded, hover, or selected rows.

properties.name: --lr-table-sticky-offset
properties.description: **`<lr-table>`** (default: `0`) — Distance a `sticky` column pins from the inline edge. Measured and set inline per column by the component so multiple sticky columns stack instead of overlapping; falls back to `0` for the first one, or before the first measurement pass.

properties.name: --lr-tag-remove-hover-background

properties.name: --lr-tag-remove-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-tag>`** (default: `var(--lr-badge-radius)`) — Corner radius of the remove button, defaulting to the tag's own corner so retuning one retunes both.

properties.name: --lr-textarea-padding

The ladder's *inline* gutter is used on every side deliberately: its block padding is `0` at the two tightest tiers because a control row's height floor supplies the space there, and a textarea has no such floor -- the first line of text would sit on the border.

properties.name: --lr-textarea-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-textarea>`** (default: `var(--lr-form-control-radius)`) — Corner radius of the field, from the active `size` tier of the shared ladder (the two tightest tiers take a smaller radius). `pill` changes the private default to `--lr-radius-pill`; a public value still wins.

properties.name: --lr-trace-tree-row-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-trace-tree>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Background of the active (`activeSpanId`) row. Shadow Parts forbids an attribute selector after `::part()`, so the active row could otherwise only be restyled by hijacking the library-wide `--lr-color-brand-quiet` token. Pairs with `--lr-trace-tree-row-active-color`: set both together, since the defaults assume the active background stays on the same side of the lightness midpoint as the ambient surface — a dark tint in light mode needs the matching text color set too, or the row's secondary text drops below the WCAG AA contrast floor.

properties.name: --lr-trace-tree-row-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-trace-tree>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Foreground reference for the active (`activeSpanId`) row. It sets the color of that row's secondary text (`detail`, `duration`, `tokens-in`, `tokens-out`, `cost`, and the `pending` status label), which is raised from the quiet token to full-strength text so it clears WCAG AA against the active row's tint. The semantic status labels keep their own hue but are mixed 25% toward this same value, so overriding it re-aims every foreground on the row at once rather than leaving the status colors stranded. See the pairing caveat on `--lr-trace-tree-row-active-bg`.
